verdict.rationale: A live probe found a real llms.txt at https://eqvista.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, text/plain). It opens with a structured product summary that an agent can be pointed at, so the core of the story is delivered. The probe only captured the header, and the support docs origin (support.eqvista.com) gave no clear llms.txt, so how far the file reaches into the help docs is unproven. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links to or indexes the support documentation, an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs on the docs origin, llms-full.txt or markdown doc variants, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
